preconditions.description: The input is a single natural number N representing the number of attractions, where 3 ≤ N ≤ 20.

postconditions.expression: all(len(row) == N for row in stdout.splitlines()) and all(row[0] == '0' for row in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: The output is an N×N adjacency matrix with zeros on the diagonal (row[i][i] = 0 for all i).

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(stdout.splitlines()[i][j]) <= 1000 for i in range(N) for j in range(N) if i != j)
postconditions.description: All off-diagonal entries are positive integers between 1 and 1000 (inclusive).

postconditions.expression: len({int(stdout.splitlines()[i][j]) for i in range(N) for j in range(N) if i != j}) == N*(N-1)//2
postconditions.description: All off-diagonal entries are pairwise distinct (no duplicate road prices).

postconditions.expression: all(sum(int(stdout.splitlines()[i][(i+k)%N]) for k in range(1,N)) == sum(int(stdout.splitlines()[i][(i+m)%N]) for m in range(1,N)) for i in range(N))
postconditions.description: For every attraction i, the sum of road prices in any Hamiltonian cycle starting at i is the same (constant total price).
